critic_summary: The single failure mode targeted: the seed prompt-l0 method (back in force after loops 2 and 3 reverted) lets the researcher commit a key quantitative parameter (frac_threshold=0.25) by proportional reasoning from a guess at typical 10s total volume, with no mechanism to confront the empirical |flow_fraction| distribution before shipping. The researcher named this in NOTES.md ("The 0.25 fraction-threshold choice is uncalibrated") and in the trace ("the method gave me no path to that calibration"), and the backtest delivered −37.85% P&L with trade_count +12.08% — the gate fires too rarely because 0.25 is far above the typical |flow_fraction| at arrival moments. The deeper meta-pattern across loops 1–4 (all four negative: −15.2%, −48.6%, −43.1%, −37.9%) is that every global modification of the base mechanism either recovers adverse orders or skips favorable ones; the base is at least a local optimum, and prior methods (single-pass, three-candidate EDA, mirror discrimination) all share the architecture 'propose a global change, then ask where it helps.' The proposed (but reverted, 1-of-5 majority vs running-best loop-1) method inverts the search direction: counterfactual segmentation forces the researcher to measure first where the base's decision disagrees with the 30s-ahead drift across three distinct binning dimensions (volume, gate-state proximity, arrival rate, spread, time-of-day), pick the single bin with the largest n×|drift|, and ship a narrowly-scoped override that touches only that bin while leaving outside-bin behavior identical to base. A dimension whose bins are all 'base correct or inconclusive' is dead at Step 3; if no dimension survives across two cycles, the loop ships nothing. If this method works in a future loop, I'd expect the next reasoning trace to (a) report per-bin counterfactual P&L numbers (n_skip, mean_30s_drift) measured before any code change, (b) show at least one candidate dimension killed at Step 3 because no bin clears the n=100, |drift|=0.5bps gate, and (c) describe a mechanism whose predicted trade_count delta is a small fraction of total arrivals — anchored to the chosen bin's measured firing rate — rather than a global redistribution of which orders are gated.
